scenario.title: Doctrine: Grace and Matter
scenario.premise: Across eight desks, build and question arguments about evil, freedom, bodies and grace. Manuscripts answer other manuscripts; agreement is not the same as victory. A completed argument reconstructs its author’s position, not a proof of belief.

stage.title: What can a letter promise?
stage.speaker: Luther · Wittenberg, 1517
stage.motivation: A reported sales promise competes with a lifetime of repentance and hungry households. Test what the letter can promise, put the money’s uses in order, and compare the ministry Luther still allows with Aquinas’s account of dependent agency.

things.label: An instrument of grace, not its independent owner

Repentance concerns a whole life, not one transaction
The household needs its remaining money for food

Meet real needs before spending on indulgences
Papal remission still deserves respect, Luther says in 1517
